parent.stage22_source_shape: 80 species, 44/36 roles, 10,013 original case sites, 66,687 frozen backgrounds

source.jittered_case_positions: the same deterministic Stage21 within-survey 50km jitter used at Stage22; all 10,013 case points moved; original 66,687 backgrounds unchanged but not needed for this paired-case diagnostic

standardization.rule: The unchanged Stage21 original-train whole-site species-balanced 0BP SD of four bioclimate fields; not fitted on jittered cases, not reestimated after results.

prespecified_descriptive_summaries.primary_unit: each of 80 species as a cluster; 10,013 paired cases in total
raw_metrics: global old/current displaced history magnitude median and IQR
paired per-case absolute history magnitude change median/P95
species summaries of median absolute h change and P95 shift
all 8 input band paired per-case absolute change medians and P95 values
prespecified_descriptive_summaries.missingness: no imputation or outcome-dependent replacement; any missing original/new raster value reported and the Stage23 source gate stops
prespecified_descriptive_summaries.terminal_decision: PASS_PAIRED_CLIMATE_PREDICTOR_SENSITIVITY_MEASURED if all exact frozen sources and 10,013 paired original/new case rows finite; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE_PAIRED_CASE_CLIMATE
